blocks.html: Use any fairy ring to travel to Zanaris. If you can start the quest, you will be redirected to the Sparse Plane.

substeps.html: If you cannot start the quest, enter and leave Zanaris via fairy rings repeatedly until Fairy Very Wise appears and talks to you. It may require up to 30 minutes after completing A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen. If you've declined her before, you have to travel by fairy ring BIR to reach her.

blocks.html: Talk to Fairy Very Wise and accept her offer. After accepting her offer, Nuff's certificate is no longer needed to reach the Fairy Resistance headquarters.

options.text: Of course I'll help. What do I need to do?

blocks.text: Talk to Gnarly.

options.text: Can I do something for you...in return for the wand?

blocks.html: In no particular order, compliment him with the following responses (Only 3 compliments may be needed to continue to the next part):
blocks.text: In no particular order, compliment him with the following responses (Only 3 compliments may be needed to continue to the next part):

substeps.html: "Your enamel shimmers like a river of silver in the moonlight."
substeps.text: "Your enamel shimmers like a river of silver in the moonlight."

substeps.html: "I've never seen such amazing, inspired and dream-like toothiness."
substeps.text: "I've never seen such amazing, inspired and dream-like toothiness."

substeps.html: "I can see your bicuspid ancestry is an example to all molar-kind."
substeps.text: "I can see your bicuspid ancestry is an example to all molar-kind."

substeps.html: "You're a wonderful guard tooth with lovely cusps."
substeps.text: "You're a wonderful guard tooth with lovely cusps."

blocks.html: Use the bucket of milk on him. Gnarly should jump into your inventory.
blocks.text: Use the bucket of milk on him. Gnarly should jump into your inventory.

options.text: Okay, I'll close my eyes.
Okay, okay! Keep your enamel on, I'll pick you up.

blocks.html: Use the fairy rings to go back to the Fairy Resistance HQ.
blocks.text: Use the fairy rings to go back to the Fairy Resistance HQ.

blocks.html: Talk to the Tooth Fairy in the south-east room, then turn on the projector.

options.text: Yes, I understand all of that.

Pain? Bring it on! Replace my tooth.
Okay, thanks.

options.text: Can I help with something?
So your tooth is really hurting, is it?
Which tooth is it that's so terribly painful and hurting?
And the pain is very high is it?
I'm a dentist; I can extract it for you!

blocks.html: In no particular order, calm him with the following responses:

substeps.html: "What's a bit of pain for a huge ork hero like you?"

substeps.html: "If the tooth isn't pulled out, all your teeth will hurt much worse!"
substeps.text: "If the tooth isn't pulled out, all your teeth will hurt much worse!"

substeps.html: "I'll make sure it doesn't hurt a bit; I'm a professional."

blocks.text: How to kill the Fairy Godfather:

substeps.html: Use all 3 teeth on the farming patches.
substeps.text: Use all 3 teeth on the farming patches.

substeps.html: Stand by the patches and kill the generals and ork warriors; Prioritise any general using the drum near the rift, to stop new orks from spawning.
substeps.text: Stand by the patches and kill the generals and ork warriors; Prioritise any general using the drum near the rift, to stop new orks from spawning.

substeps.html: Once the teeth have grown, instruct them to fight.
substeps.text: Once the teeth have grown, instruct them to fight.

substeps.html: Focus on ork warriors while the teeth focus on killing the generals.
substeps.text: Focus on ork warriors while the teeth focus on killing the generals.

substeps.html: After you and the teeth kill the generals, kill the godfather.
substeps.text: After you and the teeth kill the generals, kill the godfather.

substeps.html: You must let the teeth attack the godfather to reduce the shields. Ensure all 3 teeth are attacking the godfather at once, as each one removes a layer of his 3-layer shield.
substeps.text: You must let the teeth attack the godfather to reduce the shields. Ensure all 3 teeth are attacking the godfather at once, as each one removes a layer of his 3-layer shield.

substeps.html: If all 3 teeth are not attacking the godfather, you will not land hits as his shield will still be active. The melee tooth will not path around the player if you are in the way.
